title: Part-Time Missouri Physician
description:
About Plume :

Plume is a passion-fueled, mission-driven company that is trans-founded with a vision to transform healthcare for every trans life. We hope to make gender-affirming hormone therapy easily accessible at the touch of a button in every state of the US.
This work is deeply personal and heart-driven, and we want teammates who care about the mission and the people we serve. For the right candidates, we present a rare opportunity to do well by doing good. Plume offers an affirming, trans-centered, culturally inclusive, and fun work environment filled with purpose.
About the role:

Though this is a fully remote role, we are specifically seeking a Physician who is licensed and lives in Missouri.

As a part-time Physician with Plume , you will join our incredible team of diverse clinicians who provide GAHT (gender-affirming hormone therapy) and Expanded Clinical Services for our patients throughout the United States.

This is a part-time patient care position in which you will provide longitudinal care for a panel of patients. Your time will be spent onboarding new patients and providing follow-up care for them (lab management, prescription management, answering clinical questions). We have a large support team that takes care of patient account logistics so you can focus on clinical care.

This is a completely online, work-from-home role. We are a healthcare startup, so we are seeking folks excited about changing the paradigm of medical care so patients and clinicians are truly centered. We heavily leverage technology, so being comfortable with computers and electronic medical record systems in a rapidly changing environment is critical to doing this work.

Responsibilities:

• Conduct comprehensive, evidence-based virtual medical evaluations.

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records and sign charts within 24 hours.

• Respond to patient questions with clarity and care.

• Order necessary laboratory tests, interpret results, and prescribe appropriate medications.

• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary care team to deliver the highest standards of care.

• Dedicate a minimum of 10 patient-facing hours per week.

• Maintain Plume ’s high level of quality care, including maintaining excellent care with our above-average patient satisfaction scores, ensuring appointment availability, and responding to patient messages within one business day

Must-Have:

• Missouri license and residence

• A deep appreciation and understanding of the trans experience

• Good standing with your professional board

• Experience prescribing behavioral health medications (depression and anxiety)

• Familiarity with, and experience using, established GAHT guidelines, including an informed consent model of care

• Experience and comfort collaborating with diverse teams

• Comfortable with 100% remote patient care

• Strong technical background (familiarity with EMRs, email communication, app-based platform use, etc.)

• Strong organization and communication skills

Nice-To-Have:

• Three or more state licenses

• Experience with telehealth and preferably direct-to-consumer (DTC) telehealth/startup work

Compensation:

• $100 per hour

Plume 's Clinician compensation model has been established as a tiered system. As a clinician's panel grows, so does the amount paid per hour. This tiered system will be discussed during the interview process.

Applications for this role will be accepted until the role is filled or until 11/25/2026. Qualified applicants may begin the interview process before the closing date.
All Part-Time Employees are Eligible for:

• Accrued sick time

• Free Plume and BetterHelp subscriptions

• 401k

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack — Dots
description:
About the Team

Dots is building personal AI agents that help people make progress on their goals, including when they are away from ChatGPT. These agents can learn preferences, maintain context, work across applications, and use cloud computers to carry out tasks.

Our team brings together product engineering, design, and research to turn frontier model capabilities into useful everyday experiences. We are defining how people delegate work, understand what an agent is doing, and stay in control. Engineers help shape both the product and the systems behind it, from early prototypes through launch and iteration.

About the Role

We are looking for Senior and Staff Full Stack Software Engineers to build Dots product experiences from the interface through the services that power them. You will help define how people delegate tasks to personal agents, follow their progress, and collaborate with them over time. This role combines hands-on product development with the systems work needed to make persistent, asynchronous agent experiences reliable.

In this role, you will:

- Build and launch features across web interfaces, APIs, backend services, and data models.

- Create workflows for task creation, progress updates, agent feedback, and results that remain coherent across sessions and devices.

- Translate emerging model capabilities into product prototypes with research, product, and design partners.

- Design clear interfaces between product surfaces and agent execution systems.

- Improve performance and reliability across the stack, including user-facing latency and recovery from partial failures.

- Own projects from early exploration through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration based on user feedback.

- Help establish technical direction, testing practices, and observability as the product grows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have significant experience building and shipping products across frontend and backend systems.

- Can move comfortably between user interfaces, service design, APIs, and data modeling.

- Bring strong product instincts and care about making complex capabilities understandable to users.

- Have taken ambiguous ideas from concept to production and made practical tradeoffs between iteration speed and long-term maintainability.

- Understand asynchronous workflows and can reason about state, consistency, and failure across system boundaries.

- Collaborate effectively with design, product, research, and engineering partners.

- Have owned complex engineering projects and helped other engineers make sound technical decisions.

- Experience launching new consumer products, building agent or workflow applications, or working in small teams with broad engineering ownership is especially relevant.

- Prior experience with AI or machine learning is helpful, but not required. We welcome experienced engineers who want to bring strong product and engineering judgment to a new category of software.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
We’re a ~40 person company building the OAuth/OpenID Connect platform that large digital banks and regulated industries run their identity on. Our stack is Java on Google Cloud, delivered as a shared multi-tenant service, dedicated single-tenant clusters, and a self-managed product customers run themselves.
This is a hands-on builder role, not a management or pure-compliance role. You’ll build our security program from the ground up: writing the policies, shipping code fixes, wiring detection into GCP, and setting the practices the rest of engineering follows. You’ll lean on AI to move fast, researching how the best companies do this, drafting policies, reviewing code, and hunting vulnerabilities at a scale a lean team otherwise couldn’t reach.
What you'll do

• Stand up our vulnerability management program end to end: intake, triage, severity, remediation targets, security advisories, and coordinated disclosure, across both our managed and self-managed deployment models.

• Build our product security incident response (PSIRT): on-call, playbooks, and AI-assisted triage that turns High/Critical CVEs into paged incidents automatically.

• Work hands-on in the codebase, contributing security fixes to our Java platform and raising the bar on secure coding, secrets and key management, and hardening.

• Build proactive detection and response in GCP: alerts, monitoring, and automation where it pays off.

• Integrate security into CI/CD and IaC: dependency and container scanning, Terraform checks.

• Own our external security posture: security.txt, a security contact, a public trust page, and a security white paper.

• Get ahead of frontier-AI offensive tooling (the Mythos class of AI-discovered zero-days) by pointing AI agents at our own code before someone else does.

• Partner with platform engineers on security-relevant architecture and lead its security dimension.

• Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls pragmatically alongside engineering, without the role becoming audit admin.

What we're looking for

• A hands-on security engineer who codes. You’re comfortable reading and writing code (Java, Go a strong plus), Terraform, and GCP configs, not just reviewing others’ work.

• Strong application security foundation: secure coding, vulnerability management, security in CI/CD.

• Cloud security depth on GCP, IAM, Kubernetes, infrastructure hardening.

• Incident response experience: investigations, detection tooling, and clear communication with customers or regulators.

• You’re energized by owning the whole spectrum at a small company rather than going narrow at a large one.

• Bonus: OAuth/OIDC, FAPI, or identity-security background; ISO 27001 or SOC 2 exposure.

Why Join Us

• Own security for a platform used by large financial and regulated customers

• Work closely with founders, engineering, and customers

• Modern, cloud-native environment without unnecessary overhead

• Competitive pay and flexibility

Voor twee veranderopgaven binnen het sociaal domein van de gemeente Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren senior implementatiemanager die veranderkundige expertise combineert met implementatiekracht . Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Breng jij structuur en voortgang, zie je patronen en heb je oog voor belangen, krijg je mensen in beweging en kun je tegelijkertijd het eigenaarschap van de lijn versterken? Dan ben jij de senior implementatiemanager die we zoeken voor de ondersteuning van de teams Wet Maatschappelijke Ondersteuning (Wmo) en Jeugdgezondheidszorg (JGZ) binnen het Sociaal Domein. Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen. Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, managementteams, medewerkers en interne adviseurs. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat plannen niet op papier blijven staan, maar worden vertaald naar concrete veranderingen in werkwijzen, processen, gedrag en samenwerking.

title: GTM Strategy & Operations, APAC Lead
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a GTM Strategy & Operations Lead, you will be a founding member of our GTM Strategy & Operations team, embedded as the strategic partner to the sales leaders running our APAC sales organization.

You will own segment performance alongside those leaders: the strategy behind the number, the operating cadence and tactics that drive it, and the analysis that explains what is working and what is not. From forecasting and pipeline management to territory design, capacity planning, quota and incentive structures, and go-to-market strategy, you will touch nearly every lever that makes a sales organization perform.

This is a high-visibility seat at the center of the business. The role is a direct path to a deep understanding of commercial strategy and operational excellence in a high-growth environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Partner directly with Enterprise, Mid-Market and BDR leadership to define segment strategy, growth priorities, and execution plans.

- Translate company-level goals into segment targets, operating plans, and measurable KPIs.

- Own the forecast for your segments: run the cadence, pressure-test the calls, and give leadership a defensible view of where the quarter lands.

- Lead high-impact analyses that inform critical decisions across pipeline health, conversion, capacity planning, segmentation, incentive design, and headcount investment.

- Build the financial and operating models used to evaluate trade-offs and quantify the impact of GTM decisions.

- Own territory and account coverage design, quota setting, and the mechanics that make both defensible to reps and leadership.

- Design and run the core business cadences that create accountability: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and QBRs.

- Build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership visibility into performance, productivity, and pipeline generation.

- Establish the metrics that distinguish top performers, diagnose the root causes of underperformance, and scale what works across the team.

- Improve Salesforce and the surrounding GTM stack so data integrity, workflow efficiency, and reporting keep pace with the business.

- Project-manage cross-functional initiatives spanning Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Engineering & Product, Finance, Recruiting, and Operations.

- Find novel ways to use Factory droids to automate the reporting, analysis, and deal support work that would otherwise consume the team.

- Roll up your sleeves on immediate problems while building the long-term infrastructure, and present clear, structured recommendations to senior leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 4+ years of professional experience, ideally in consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or a high-growth startup.

- Strong analytical skills: You go deep on data and structure analyses quickly to answer the business question at hand. You know the data underneath your work, including where it comes from, how it's built, and where it falls short. You can defend your numbers and have a point of view.

- Ownership: You take initiative, drive problems to the finish, bring in the right people at the right time, and hold yourself accountable for the outcome.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

This includes the whole employee life cycle, from attracting new joiners, on-boarding, development throughout their career, ensuring they work in a balanced and healthy way, supporting them when needed, enabling efficient and effective processes throughout, every day, for their entire journey at Baringa. 

As we continue to grow organically, we need to ensure our people offerings are set up to enable the future size and shape of the business to operate effectively and efficiently, using the appropriate tools. Supporting the ever-evolving business needs and being a key player in the change management of the firm, is a core part of this role.

• Build trusted relationships and provide support and advice to Partner Leads in helping them deliver the people elements of their business plans. • Support organisational change and transformation activity within your client group(s), helping leaders navigate change and manage people impacts effectively.

• Support leaders and people managers on a range of people matters, including organisational effectiveness, talent, engagement, performance and development, helping to ensure teams are set up for success.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here - and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy helps our customers, partners and colleagues become self-sufficient with the Quantexa Platform. We do that through online learning, instructor-led sessions and bespoke digital resources that let every user harness the power of our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Learning Designer to join our Design & Publish Team within Education Services. You'll turn complex technical topics - data, analytics, software and FinTech - into clear, engaging and accessible learning experiences, taking projects from first conversation with a subject matter expert through to a polished, published solution.

This is a role for an independent problem solver. You'll own your design projects end to end, decide how best to approach each one, and organize your own time across several priorities at once, spotting risks early and keeping stakeholders informed without needing to be chased. You'll work alongside Product, R&D and Delivery experts, and have the room to bring your own ideas on tools, approaches and how we use AI to design better learning.

This is a hybrid role, with the expectation of attending the company office in central London 2-3 days a week.

- Plan and track your own design projects, flagging risks and blockers early and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

- Identify, propose and lead the introduction of new tools, processes or AI approaches that improve our learning design and the learner experience.

- Support teammates through feedback and knowledge sharing, and take the lead on projects where it's useful.

- Hands-on experience designing learning content with authoring and design tools (we use Articulate Rise).

title: National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH) Volunteer
description:
Department: Victim Services
Position: National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH) Volunteer
FLSA Status: Not Specified (Not Applicable)
About RAINN

Since 1994, RAINN (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network) has helped millions of people affected by sexual violence and we're just getting started. As the nation's largest anti-sexual violence organization and operator of the National Sexual Assault Hotline (1-800-656-HOPE), we lead the fight against sexual violence by expanding prevention, ensuring justice, and providing healing to create safer communities.
Our mission is to stop sexual violence by supporting survivors, holding perpetrators accountable, and creating safer communities and we do it through three pillars:
Prevention - Educating the public and inspiring action through media, entertainment, and direct outreach
Justice - Leading bipartisan policy campaigns and working to hold every offender accountable
Healing - Providing free, confidential, 24/7 support through the National Sexual Assault Hotline, DoD Safe Helpline, and other programs
Volunteers are at the heart of this work. By joining RAINN , you become part of a movement that has answered millions of calls, shaped national policy, and given hope to survivors across the country.
If you or someone you know needs support, free and confidential help is available 24/7: call 800.656.HOPE (4673), chat at rainn.org, or text HOPE to 64673.
Position Summary
The National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH), operated by RAINN , provides live, secure, anonymous crisis support to the growing number of people who prefer communicating online through a simple instant message format, giving those affected by sexual assault a safe place to receive support.
NSAH volunteers are responsible for providing high-quality services to users of the National Sexual Assault Hotline, including but not limited to survivors of sexual assault and their loved ones. Volunteers also receive extensive and ongoing crisis-intervention training as well as professional development and coaching opportunities.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Utilize crisis intervention best practices including safety planning, brainstorming, and listening skills to provide compassionate support to hotline users.

• Complete regular training on serving NSAH users.

• Answer inbound crisis-intervention online chats to NSAH users.

• Support NSAH users and provide accurate referral services.

• Maintain knowledge and adhere to RAINN 's and NSAH's policies and protocols.

• Assist with NSAH specific data collection by completing session assessments during each shift.

• Attend and participate in any additional training for all NSAH volunteers.

Qualification Requirements

• Tech-savvy with experience using instant messaging and digital communication platforms.

• Ability to convey empathy over instant messaging.

• Ability to type at least 35 words per minute.

• Ability to work well under pressure and maintain composure during stressful situations; ability to handle shifting and multiple priorities.

• Ability to solve problems and deal with a wide range of situations.

• Ability to interpret a variety of written instructions.

• Ability to exercise good judgment when faced with complex decisions.

• Ability to receive and implement feedback.

• Resiliently positive and energetic attitude, with the ability to successfully work on a team and independently.

• Willingness to work a non-traditional schedule, including evenings and weekends.

Preferred Qualifications

• At least 1-year of professional experience in one or more of the following:

• Working with vulnerable populations and/or survivors of sexual violence.

• Working in human resources, social services, or customer service.

• Crisis hotline/intervention experience (volunteer or paid position).

• Experience using an online learning platform.

title: Channel Sales Manager, Los Angeles
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

As a Channel Sales Manager , you'll be pivotal in scaling Verkada's reach and impact by developing and managing a network of high-performing reseller partners. You'll be responsible for driving net new business through the channel-building pipeline and executing strategic plans that result in measurable growth.

This individual contributor role requires strategic thinking and hands-on execution as you collaborate across sales, marketing, and partner teams to grow Verkada’s presence in Southern California.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be at the heart of Verkada’s mission, working hand-in-hand with our sales teams to drive growth and success with channel partners. You’ll be responsible for building pipeline and generating net new business through reseller partners while executing a best-in-class channel strategy. Here’s what you’ll own:

• Drive Net New Pipeline: Proactively identify and generate pipeline with net new end-user customers through strategic reseller partners. Collaborate closely with field sales teams to co-sell and close high-value opportunities.

title: Strategic Account Director – PSU/Government
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?
If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
About the Role:
Kong is the AI Connectivity Company. We build the infrastructure that lets enterprises govern APIs and AI traffic at scale - and that infrastructure is becoming critical to how India's government and public sector modernize their systems.
We're hiring an Account Executive to own a defined patch of PSU (Public Sector Undertaking) and Government accounts across India. You'll work the full government buying cycle - tenders, GeM listings, System Integrator relationships, empanelment - to bring Kong 's platform into major public-sector modernization programs.
This role is based in Delhi and reports to a Country Manager.
What You'll Do:

• Own the sales cycle, government-style. Lead deals from first conversation through RFP response, technical and financial bid submission, and contract award. Track PQ (pre-qualification) criteria, EMD requirements, and L1 bidding dynamics. Keep your pipeline accurate to what's actually documented in the tender process - not what looks good in a forecast.

• Work the ecosystem, not just the account. Government and PSU deals rarely close direct. Build real relationships with the System Integrators (SIs) and OEM partners who carry the technical bid, and make sure Kong is positioned - and empanelled - before the tender drops.

• Navigate multiple stakeholders. IT Secretaries, CTOs and CIOs at PSUs, nodal officers, procurement and finance committees - each has different priorities and a different definition of "done." Map them accurately and plan around all of them.

• Build account plans for your patch. Identify which departments and PSUs are actively modernizing, where their budget cycles sit, and what a realistic path to close looks like. Then execute against it.

• Get fluent in the platform and the landscape. Know Kong 's API and AI governance platform well enough to defend it in a technical bid, and know where competitors are already empanelled.

• Meet your number. Consistently hit quota. Government cycles are long - consistency across quarters matters more than any single deal.

• Bring in the rest of Kong early. Loop in sales engineering, legal, and the channel team before compliance and certification requirements (STQC, data residency, MeitY empanelment) become a bottleneck late in the deal.

• Travel. Expect real time in government offices and PSU sites across India. This is a relationship business, and relationships in this sector are built in person.

What You'll Bring:

• 8-12 years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology sales, with direct experience selling into Indian government departments or PSUs. This isn't optional - the public-sector buying process is different enough that generalist enterprise experience alone won't carry you.

• A track record of consistently hitting quota (typically in the ₹2-5 Cr / $300K-$750K range) sold through longer, multi-stakeholder government cycles.

• Working knowledge of India's government tendering lifecycle - GeM, RFP/RFI processes, technical and financial bids, PQ criteria, EMD - and how empanelment with bodies like MeitY or NIC actually works in practice.

• Established relationships with System Integrators and OEM partners active in India's public-sector technology space.

• Process discipline and patience. Government deals move on their own timeline. You bring structure to that timeline - you don't try to force it.

• Executive presence with senior government officials and PSU leadership , along with the judgment to know when to push and when to wait.

• Ownership with collaboration. You run your patch, but you know when to pull in your manager, sales engineering, or a partner. In the public sector, this isn't a solo sport.

What You'll Do:

Own data quality and governance across our Go-to-Market systems

• Own the accuracy, completeness, and structure of Salesforce account and contact data, including the segmentation that drives our targeting - organization type, size, and the fundraising systems each nonprofit already runs.

• Build enrichment and validation into a repeatable process, so data quality is maintained by design rather than by cleanup.

• Own the Salesforce territory model - account ownership, territory assignments, and the analysis behind how territories are distributed and rebalanced as the team grows - and keep Sales and the SDR team working from the same view of who owns what.

Improve how the sales organization operates

• Identify where AEs lose time or where process breaks down, then fix it, automate it, or write the requirement for our Salesforce architect.

Support enablement and onboarding

• Give Enablement the adoption and performance data behind the training - who is using which tools and plays, what is working, and where coaching will have the most impact.

• Help new AEs and SDRs reach productivity faster by owning the tooling, data access, and templates in their onboarding.

Scale the prospecting and outbound infrastructure

• Administer the prospecting and sales engagement stack, and build the reusable list templates and sequence library that let any AE or SDR self-serve in minutes rather than starting from scratch.

• Run start-of-quarter working sessions with Enablement where AEs and SDRs build their own outbound from that library.

Build reporting that drives decisions

• Develop dashboards and reporting that let sales leaders make faster, better-informed decisions on pipeline, coverage, velocity, and territory performance.

• Support the VP of Rev Ops with monthly KPI and forecast cycle to definitions that hold up under scrutiny from Finance and our board.

title: Principal Platform Engineer, DevOps and Deployment (Regulated AI Software)
description:
ESQlabs is an innovative, internationally active Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a global leader in the development and application of the Open Systems Pharmacology (OSP) Suite. We combine mechanistic modeling, Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK) and Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP), with software and training to support Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Next-Generation Risk Assessment (NGRA) for pharmaceutical, chemical, and academic partners worldwide. Our mission is to empower life sciences: helping scientists understand mechanisms of disease and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized, safer, and more efficient treatment and testing strategies.
We are building a platform where AI agents help scientists set up regulated modeling analyses, and fixed, versioned procedures run them. This job is about the engine room: the compute core, the release pipeline and the operations.

About the role
You make sure our analyses can be reproduced, shipped to clients and checked later. You own the compute core, the release pipeline, deployment into client environments, and the metering and provenance behind every result. The AI layer has its own lead and team; you build what they run on. The Quality Manager sets the standards, you implement them. You report to the CEO.
Key Responsibilities

• Make the scientific compute core deterministic: pinned R, Python and solver toolchains, content-addressed container images with a software bill of materials, and tests that prove byte-identical re-execution on a reference platform and tolerance-bounded re-execution across platforms.

• Build the services the AI layer runs on: isolated executors per client without network access, usage metering per call, the signed record and the certificate behind every result. You build the policy engine and the tool router together with the AI lead.

• Expose the platform as a versioned API and as tools for AI agents with one shared contract, and ship the reproducibility package that re-executes a run outside the platform.

• Run the evaluation pipeline in continuous integration: conformance tests against reference case sets, re-execution tests, regression tests, results stored per procedure version.

• Own release engineering and operations: CI/CD pipelines, signed and content-addressed releases, scripted installation qualification, environment management (hosted, in a client tenant, later offline), monitoring, incident handling and the operating model the deployment engineer runs.

• Implement the technical controls behind the information security and AI management standards the Quality Manager owns.

What you bring

• At least five years of platform, infrastructure or backend engineering with senior ownership of a production system.

• Reproducible builds and execution in practice: dependency pinning, artifact hashing, immutable versioning, supply chain integrity. Hermetic build systems are a strong plus.

• Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator, monitoring, and release management for environments you don’t fully control.

• API design where the schema was a contract with external consumers, including versioning and deprecation in practice.

• Security engineering for multi-tenant systems: isolation, secrets, authorization, and awareness of the risks of language-model-driven systems. Exposure to GxP or equivalent regulated software is valuable; interest in acquiring it is required.

What's in store for you

The dynamic team behind ESQlabs unites people with different backgrounds, spanning disciplines like pharmaceutical sciences, physics, bioinformatics, mathematics, data science, and software engineering. Our trust in each other, our open-mindedness, and our constant quest for excellence and innovation unite us. We value flat hierarchies, where everyone can contribute ideas and expertise to develop the best product. We are passionate, always willing to broaden our horizons, and love our start-up culture.

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

title: Business Technology Consultant
description:
MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem.

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for two Business Technology Consultants to join our growing IT team.

The Role in Two Bullet Points

• Take business problems from a vague request to a working, adopted solution.

• Hands-on systems, automation and AI delivery across Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Revenue, Finance, Royalties and Marketing.

Let's be honest!
This is a small team with big aspirations, and a rare chance to reshape how a growing business runs on technology. It is also a role where you are expected to own the outcome, not just the idea.

This role is not for: people who prefer to write the requirement and hand it to someone else to build; specialists who want to work on one platform only; or anyone who needs a project manager to tell them what to do next. If you need a bit more information...
We are hiring two complementary generalists who get things done. Each has broad practical technology skills and end-to-end ownership: work out what is really needed, choose the simplest thing that will work, configure or build it, and make sure people use it. Some weeks that means automating a manual process; others it means connecting two systems, fixing a report nobody trusts, or running a small project end to end. Specialist partners handle the deep platform work. Your job is to make sure the work actually ships.
What you will do

• Shape problems: map how things work today, find the real requirement and challenge it where it needs challenging.

• Choose solutions: configuration, an existing tool, an integration, code or a partner, picking what gives the most value soonest.

• Integrate: build small integrations and improve the ones we have, so data moves reliably between Salesforce, Sage, YayPay, Snowflake and our other tools.

• Automate: workflows, manual steps and reports, using low-code and AI tools to move fast and checking their output carefully.

• Ship safely: test, document and hand over to support, so nothing depends on you to keep running.

• Land the change: plan training and communication, and follow up until the old way stops.

You'll love this role if...

• You have personally taken business problems from request to adopted solution, more than once, including outside your main platform.

• You have built or improved integrations between business systems: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, field mapping, matching and error handling, using integration or workflow tools.

• You are comfortable with SQL and data, and with low-code automation. Scripting or coding is a plus, not a requirement.

• You use AI tools to analyse, prototype and build, and check their output before it is used. You take responsibility for the quality and safety of what ships.

• You understand data: IDs, duplicates, sync and what makes a number trustworthy.

• You work directly with non-technical colleagues, challenge confidently and explain simply.

• You care about production discipline: version control, testing, security and documentation.

Nice to have: Salesforce, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform, Snowflake, Sage or HubSpot; experience in a consultancy, a scale-up or a small internal systems team where you wore several hats. Benefits

• Salary between £65,000 and £80,000 depending on experience

• Remote role with occasional travel

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

• Private healthcare including optical and dental cover and an online GP service

• Life insurance

title: Backend Engineer - Integration Platform
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.
Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.
To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.
BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.
Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.
About the role
BLP’s AI agents are only as good as their data: they need reliable context from our customers’ ERP systems, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics , or Oracle, and a safe way to write their results back.
We are forming a new backend platform team, and you will be one of its first engineers. You will start by learning our existing data synchronization platform, keeping it reliable, and gradually taking ownership of it. From there, you will build the backend services and tooling that let BLP connect to any ERP system through configuration instead of custom code.
What you'll do

• Shape the platform: work with the engineers and implementation teams who connect our customers’ ERP systems, find where that work is slow or fragile, and turn it into platform improvements.

• Build great software: design and build clean, maintainable services in Go, and raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews.

• Lead technically: drive technical decisions on key initiatives, influence the product roadmap, and support your teammates as they grow.

• Improve how we work: share what you learn openly and keep improving our processes, tools, and team practices.

• Tech stack: Go, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub CI/CD, running on GCP.

What you bring

• 3+ years as a software engineer, with a degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

• Experience with Go, or strong backend experience and the motivation to learn Go quickly

• Craftsmanship: a solid grasp of Clean Code and Clean Architecture

• Product thinking: you turn business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately code

• Ownership: you take responsibility for your code, the product, and the team

• Clear communication: you simplify complex systems and explain them to engineers and business stakeholders alike

• Fluent English: you work comfortably in English, in writing and in conversation

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GCP and infrastructure as code.

• Experience with observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana or Google Cloud Monitoring.

• German.

What you'll get

• Real leverage: every improvement you make to the platform speeds up go-lives and stabilizes integrations for hundreds of enterprise customers.

• Full ownership: from internal user problem to shipped and operated code.

• A modern, varied tech stack and continuous learning as the platform scales.

• Fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

• Regular team events.

Practical information

• Location: Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week.

• Employment: full-time, permanent.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design
description:
Overview
We are designing the grid of the future!
EPE is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design (P.E. required) to lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage substations ranging from 34.5 kV through 345 kV and higher. This role will support our Owner's Engineering group, with a primary emphasis on physical substation design and the delivery of complete engineering packages from conceptual design through Approved for Construction (AFC). The ideal candidate will bring experience leading both greenfield and brownfield substation projects, with a strong understanding of physical design and exposure to Testing & Commissioning (T&C), as well as protection and control (P&C) design.
Our projects include utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), wind and hybrid collector substations, point-of-interconnection switching stations, and large-load interconnections supporting data centers and industrial customers across ERCOT and other U.S. markets. As a technical lead, you will guide engineers and designers, review and verify engineering deliverables, and collaborate directly with clients, transmission owners, and EPC contractors to deliver high-quality substation solutions.
Responsibilities
How you can make an impact:

• Lead design from concept to IFC: Own the technical scope, quality and schedule of substation design packages through conceptual, 30%, 60%, 90% and IFC milestones.

• Physical design: Develop and check general arrangements, plan and section drawings, electrical clearances and phase spacing, rigid and strain bus design, equipment and structure layouts, ground grid design (IEEE 80), lightning shielding (IEEE 998), raceway (conduit, cable trench, duct bank), lighting and bills of material.

• P&C design: Develop and check one-line and three-line diagrams, AC and DC schematics, wiring diagrams, relay and control panel layouts, and cable schedules. Apply protection schemes for lines, transformers, buses, breakers and capacitor banks, including line current differential, distance, transformer and bus differential, breaker failure, and communication-assisted tripping (POTT, DTT).

• Brownfield expansions: Lead field verification and reviews of existing conditions, integrate new bays, line terminals and P&C into energized substations, and develop outage, cutover and construction sequencing with the utility.

• Utility and market interface: Apply transmission owner design standards and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO and other ISOs/RTOs), and support coordination on metering, telemetry and SCADA/communications.

• Equipment and vendors: Write technical specifications and evaluate vendor proposals and drawings for power transformers, circuit breakers, switches, instrument transformers, relay panels, control enclosures, station service and DC systems.

• Design reviews: Review EPC and third-party substation and collection system design packages, and provide clear, actionable comments to clients, both on EPE design projects and on owner's engineering assignments.

• Proposals and estimating: Support scope development, engineering hour estimates and conceptual cost estimates for new work.

• Mentoring and QA/QC: Mentor engineers and designers, check their work, and uphold EPE quality standards. Seal drawings as engineer of record where licensed.

• Coordination and construction support: Coordinate with civil/structural, transmission line, system studies and communications/SCADA teams. Submit and respond to RFIs, and support construction and commissioning.

• Deliver assigned projects on time while meeting project quality and budget objectives.

Qualifications
Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with a minimum of six years of high-voltage and MV substation design experience with a utility, consulting firm or EPC.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license (required).

• Proven exp

title: Senior Data Engineer — Knowledge Ingestion
description:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build the four source connectors and ingestion pipeline that turns raw knowledge content into a governed, permission-tagged corpus in S3 and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. You’ll own the ingestion workstream end to end inside an architecture set by the Solution Architect, working paired with the retrieval engineer so no deliverable sits with one person.

The mission: get every in-scope item from four source systems into the index with its metadata, permissions, and lineage intact - on a sync schedule the client can tune, with retirement propagating on the next run.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build the iKNOW connector against Oracle B2C Service knowledge APIs - full inventory extract, then incremental sync by modified date with article status and answer version captured.

- Build SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams connectors on Microsoft Graph - site and drive enumeration, delta queries for incremental change, and capture of sharing and group membership as permission metadata on every item.

- Build the Sitecore connector against its content APIs for public web content in scope.

- Implement the ingestion pipeline - landing in S3 with per-source prefix convention, document conversion and text extraction, deduplication by content hash, metadata enrichment from taxonomy, and Bedrock Knowledge Base data source sync with chunking parameters set by the architect.

- Produce inventory extracts for content disposition reviews and counts that feed the end-of-Phase-1 re-baselining.

- Implement retirement handling - items marked retired or deleted at source are removed from the index on the next sync.

- Handle throttling and backoff for Oracle and Microsoft APIs, idempotent re-runs, and failure isolation per source so one connector’s outage does not stall the others.

- Instrument every pipeline stage with CloudWatch metrics and write the ingestion runbooks.

- Pair with client IT during weeks 7-10 so they can run, re-run, and extend the pipelines after transition.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- 4+ years building data pipelines in production, at least 2 of them on AWS with Python.

- Hands-on with Microsoft Graph API for SharePoint and Teams content - delta queries, permissions, and throttling - or equivalent enterprise content platform experience.

- Experience landing unstructured content (HTML, Office documents, PDF, chat transcripts) into S3 and preparing it for search or vector indexing.

- Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases data sources and sync behavior, or a comparable vector ingestion path on OpenSearch.

- Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or AWS CDK and CI for pipeline deployment into a client-owned account.

- Comfortable working from a shared backlog in client repositories with documentation written as the work is done.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- AWS Certified Data Engineer Associate.

- Prior integration with Oracle B2C Service or another Oracle Service Cloud product.

- Prior integration with Sitecore XM or XP content APIs.

- Experience with AWS Glue, Step Functions, or EventBridge for orchestration, and with document parsing libraries for Office and PDF formats.

When you join Solvd, you'll…

- Shape real-world AI
